# AMRT.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp1,530.0 against Rp975.0 (expected total return 61.1%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Staples retail (minimarkets, supermarkets).
